title: Claude has been an absolute beast bringing this together.
author: Dead_Fox_7
selftext: Got the four seasons in a good first pass and am just sitting back watching it with a grin. "Huh, it's actually working. Neat."

comments.author: papapumpnz
comments.body: Well done on the prompt. Claude has been nothing but a complete disappointment to me in my efforts. What was your prompt like? Did you build out detailed design docs and ask it to follow it? or just add and update as you went along?

replies.author: Dead_Fox_7
replies.body: Went the whole constitution and and module route and just took it one module at a time with slight deviations here and there to clean up things that would be a headache in later modules.

replies.author: Delicious-Duty6546
replies.body: One shotting games is not the way to go. Have it build robust systems one at a time with strong documentation.

comments.author: Lordxb
comments.body: Interesting, theirs no way Claude did the modals but looks very nice. However, the chars need proper turn animations and stop!!

replies.author: Dead_Fox_7
replies.body: Correct. Models were made mainly in Grok (animated there too). Still trying to decide best approach to model turning. Currently it's just the walk animation for all actions including idle animations. The exception being the dog and chickens

replies.author: Lordxb
replies.body: Grok is good for that… very good with generating full sprites!!

replies.author: Dead_Fox_7
replies.body: Added to the list to take a look at. Thanks!

comments.author: reality_comes
comments.body: Is this using an engine or all custom?

replies.author: Dead_Fox_7
replies.body: Custom. But the only reason I went that route is because Claude recommended it and not through any cleverness on my part. I laid out what I was looking to achieve and it recommended python/pygame. Since my background is illustration, who was I to know any better?

comments.author: Crawling_Hustler
comments.body: Bro, where did u get the tiles ? Plz dont tell claude did it

replies.author: Dead_Fox_7
replies.body: Actually that was all me :) Couldn't get grok or nano or seedream to get me what I wanted, so I just drew them.

comments.author: OkCellist4993
comments.body: Does grok make sprite sheets that already fit with godot animation2d?

replies.author: Dead_Fox_7
replies.body: Not sure about the Godot part as I'm unfamiliar, but ended up using [sorceress.games](http://sorceress.games) for all of my sprite sheets once I had a good animation. It's just a nice one stop shop for a lot of things tied to what I'm doing. It's a paid site, but one time fee (plus credits for ai model usage when needed) but most of things I use it for don't need any credits (like making sprite sheets)

comments.author: TheKaleKing
comments.body: The music is so good. Did you use eleven labs to generate it? Can you share the prompt?

replies.author: Dead_Fox_7
replies.body:
Thanks! I've got a pretty big track list now that will be based on seasons. Suno for the song. I have a love/hate with Suno as you'll see in the prompt (which it ignores for most of my songs, but it does have a decent studio that I can use to remove any drums I don't want). Only speaking from my own experience, but I find the simpler the better:

"violin, Celtic, cello, deep bass strings, happy, uplifting, work song, inspirational, NO DRUMS,   
  
  
Negative: flute, electric guitar, guitar, pop, synth, solo female vocals, drums"

replies.author: TheKaleKing
replies.body: Thanks for sharing. The music is so important though it can truly make or break the mood of a game. We all remember some of our favorite childhood games music track, and I feel like you nailed that really well!

replies.author: Dead_Fox_7
replies.body: Appreciate that and I completely agree!

comments.author: Caitlin_Shaw
comments.body: i personally love the aesthetics so much

comments.author: GTTGgames
comments.body: been having an amazing time with opus 5 helping me get my vision across. excited to post vids from the new game soon - dig the dog ending!

comments.author: Ok_Trick6151
comments.body: looks good! how long did it take you to make all of this?
